param_input_item.param_description: a character vector, a cell array of character vectors, or a string array: names of .gz files or folders, with wildcards '*' and '?' allowed; or one http/https URL.
a character vector or string scalar: folder of the decompressed files, created if needed.
a nonnegative integer: largest size in bytes of each decompressed file (default: Inf, no limit).
a positive number: a file whose decompressed size is more than maxratio times the size of its .gz file is refused (default: Inf, no limit).

param_output_item.param_description: a cell array of character vectors: names of the written files.

description.p: gunzip decompresses each .gz file. The output name is the name of the .gz file without its '.gz' extension.
Without output folder, each file is written next to its .gz file. A folder gives all the .gz files it contains; other files are ignored.
A URL is downloaded to a temporary file first. Without output folder, the result is written in the current folder.

Protection against decompression bombs: MaxExtractedSize limits the size of each decompressed file (error Nelson:io:gzip:tooLarge), and MaxCompressionRatio is checked while decompressing. Writing stops with an error when the free disk space of the destination is not enough.
Several gzip members put one after the other are decompressed as one file. A damaged file raises an error.
Ctrl+C stops the decompression and removes the file being written.

history_item.history_description: initial version, with MaxExtractedSize and MaxCompressionRatio options
